alt: 球場上兩隊人馬隔著一顆球緊張對峙，中間的人伸出雙手勸阻。
scene_prompt: On a modern school sports court just before conflict erupts, two opposing adult recreational teams face each other across a narrow gap, tense shoulders, clenched fists low at sides, angry expressions. A loose ball rests precisely between them; one peacemaker holds open palms between the groups. Nobody has struck anyone. Clearly precarious tense moment before an outbreak, no weapons or explosions.
